THE RULE: a single shortest path tells you an edge EXISTS, not what cutting one parent ACHIEVES -- yield-per-cut needs the full parent set, and a masked second parent is invisible by construction. P6 must NOT infer per-cut yields from this display; either enumerate all parents per edge or re-measure after each cut. Identical failure mode to the grep audit above: a tool answering a narrower question (does an edge exist / does a file contain a string) than the one being asked of it (what does cutting this parent buy).
